title: aster laricifolius
intro: Aster laricifolius, commonly known as Korean aster, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Aster laricifolius include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
